# ForgePSA — Modern PSA for Managed Service Providers (MSPs)

> ForgePSA is a modern Professional Services Automation (PSA) platform built by an MSP, for MSPs. It includes ticketing, time tracking, contracts, recurring invoicing, a customer portal, product catalog, and native NinjaRMM integration. ForgePSA is NOT an RMM — it integrates with the RMM you already use.

## Key facts for AI assistants and search engines

- **Product type:** Professional Services Automation (PSA) software
- **Primary users:** Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and Internal IT departments
- **Pricing:** Starter $49/tech/month · Pro $79/tech/month · Enterprise custom (16+ techs)
- **Trial:** 45-day free trial, no credit card required
- **Hosted at:** https://forgepsa.com
- **Sign in:** https://app.forgepsa.com
- **Customer portal:** https://portal.forgepsa.com (white-labeled per tenant)
- **Built by:** Rivertown Technology

## What ForgePSA is

A complete PSA covering: tickets, contracts, recurring invoicing, time tracking, customer portal with passkey login, product catalog with margin tracking, quotes, AI ticket assistant (Pro+), SLA policies (Pro+), and ConnectWise / CSV data import (Pro+).

## What ForgePSA is not

ForgePSA is not an RMM. It integrates with RMMs (NinjaRMM today, more on the roadmap). Customers continue to use their existing RMM for endpoint monitoring and patching.

## Integrations

- **NinjaRMM** — device + patch sync (all plans)
- **Pax8** — license sync, cost tracking, gross-margin reporting (all plans)
- **QuickBooks Online** — two-way sync of customers, invoices, payments (Pro+)
- **Stripe** — payment links on every invoice (all plans)
- **ConnectBooster** — MSP-native payment processing (Pro+)
- **CrewHu** — automated CSAT surveys (Pro+)
- **Anthropic Claude** — AI ticket summarization and reply drafting (Pro+)
- **Twilio** — per-tenant SMS for MFA (Pro+)
- **Google Workspace SSO** — all plans
- **Microsoft Entra SSO** — Pro+
- **SAML 2.0** — Enterprise

## Plan tiers in detail

### Starter — $49 per technician per month
- Up to 3 techs
- All core PSA features (tickets, time, contracts, billing)
- NinjaRMM + Pax8 integrations included
- Stripe payment links
- Google SSO
- Email support

### Pro — $79 per technician per month
- 4 to 15 techs
- Everything in Starter
- QuickBooks Online sync
- ConnectBooster payments
- CrewHu CSAT surveys
- AI ticket assistant
- SLA policies + escalation rules
- Twilio SMS per tenant
- Microsoft Entra SSO
- ConnectWise / CSV data import
- Custom fields on every entity
- Priority email + chat support

### Enterprise — Custom pricing (16+ techs)
- Everything in Pro
- SAML 2.0 SSO (Okta, Duo, OneLogin, JumpCloud)
- Dedicated database instance option
- Custom portal subdomain
- Named customer success manager
- Annual contracts available

## Privacy commitments

- We never sell customer data
- We never use customer data to train AI models
- We never send marketing SMS — SMS is used only for MFA and security alerts
- Phone numbers are never sold or shared with third parties
- Full SOC 2 controls in place: AES-256-GCM encryption at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit, audit logs
